db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file used by lastlog2. Corresponds to -d/--database.

active.description: Print last login records excluding users who have never logged in. Corresponds to -a/--active.

before_days.description: Print only last login records older than this number of days. Corresponds to -b/--before. Null means no filter.

time_days.description: Print only last login records more recent than this number of days. Corresponds to -t/--time. Null means no filter.

service.description: Display PAM service used to login in the last column. Corresponds to -s/--service.

users.description: List of specific usernames to print records for. Corresponds to -u/--users. Empty list prints all users.
